=LET(
    Data, ARRAYFORMULA(VLOOKUP($A$8, '거래처'!$C$2:$J, {5,6,7}, 0)),
    ValA, INDEX(Data, 1, 1),
    ValB, INDEX(Data, 1, 2),
    ValC, INDEX(Data, 1, 3),
    Money, IF(ValC="", 0, ValC) & "원",
    IFERROR(HSTACK(ValA, ValB, Money), "-")
)

=LET(
  homeCnt,   COUNTIF('홈멀티'!E13:E, ">=1"),
  commCnt,   COUNTIF('상업멀티'!F4:F, ">=1"),
  homeText,  IF(homeCnt>0, ROUND('홈멀티'!$L$2 * 100, 1) & "%", ""),
  commText,  IF(commCnt>0, ROUND('상업멀티'!$L$2 * 100, 1) & "%", ""),
  joined,    TEXTJOIN(" / ", TRUE, commText, homeText),
  IF(joined="", "", joined)
)

=LET(
  homeCnt,     COUNTIF('홈멀티'!E13:E, ">=1"),
  commCnt,     COUNTIF('상업멀티'!F4:F, ">=1"),
  homePct,     ROUND('홈멀티'!$K$2 * 100, 1),
  fCnt,        SUM('상업멀티'!F4:F65,'상업멀티'!F88:F96,'상업멀티'!F344:F352,'상업멀티'!F353:F415)  >= 1,
  gCnt,        SUM('상업멀티'!F66:F87,'상업멀티'!F97:F108) >= 1,
  commPct,     ROUND('상업멀티'!$K$2 * 100, 1),
  commThresh,  IF( AND(fCnt, gCnt),
                   103,
                   IF(fCnt, 103,
                     IF(gCnt, 120, "")
                   )
                 ),
  homeText,    IF(
                  homeCnt>0,
                  "홈멀티: " & homePct & "%" &
                    IF(homePct>0, " (최대 130%)", ""),
                  ""
                ),
  commText,    IF(
                  commCnt>0,
                  "상업멀티: " & commPct & "%" &
                    IF(commPct>0, " (최대 " & commThresh & "%)", ""),
                  ""
                ),
  joined,      TEXTJOIN(" / ", TRUE, homeText, commText),
  IF(joined="", "-", joined)
)

=LET(
  chkHome, REGEXMATCH(TO_TEXT('홈멀티'!E1), "의심"),
  chkComm, REGEXMATCH(TO_TEXT('상업멀티'!F1), "의심"),
  
  msgParts, TEXTJOIN(" / ", TRUE, 
    IF(chkHome, "홈멀티", ""), 
    IF(chkComm, "상업멀티", "")
  ),
  
  IF(msgParts="", "모델 구분", "주의! " & msgParts & " 실내기 대수 확인")
)
=IF('전표생성폼'!D19,"전체 합계 (VAT별도)","전체 합계 (VAT포함)") & IF('전표생성폼'!A14, CHAR(10) & "<카드 수수료 포함>", "")

=IFERROR(LET(
  homeArr, HSTACK(
    '홈멀티'!A4:A,'홈멀티'!B4:B,'홈멀티'!C4:C,'홈멀티'!E4:E,'홈멀티'!D4:D,
    MAP('홈멀티'!F4:F,LAMBDA(x,IF(x="","",x))),
    MAP('홈멀티'!G4:G,LAMBDA(x,IF(x="","",x)))
  ),
  commArr, HSTACK(
    '상업멀티'!A4:A,'상업멀티'!B4:B,'상업멀티'!D4:D,'상업멀티'!F4:F,'상업멀티'!E4:E,
    MAP('상업멀티'!G4:G,LAMBDA(x,IF(x="","",x))),
    MAP('상업멀티'!H4:H,LAMBDA(x,IF(x="","",x)))
  ),
  singleModel,'싱글 세트'!A4:A,
  singlePyeong,'싱글 세트'!B4:B,
  fArr,'싱글 세트'!F4:F,
  k2Val,TRIM('싱글 세트'!L2),
  l2Val,k2Val="리모컨제외",
  n2Val,TRIM('싱글 세트'!O2),
  o2Val,TRIM('싱글 세트'!Q2),
  r2Val,TRIM('싱글 세트'!T2),
  idxArr,SEQUENCE(ROWS(singleModel),1,4),
  singleName, MAP(singleModel,singlePyeong,fArr,singleModel,LAMBDA(mdl,py,f,aVal,
    LET(
      m, TRIM(mdl),
      p, TRIM(py),
      a, TO_TEXT(aVal),
      name, IF(AND(m<>"",p<>""), m & " " & p & "평", m),
      kF, AND(f>=1, NOT(l2Val), REGEXMATCH(a, "360|4way|1way|싱글 덕트|싱글 실링"), k2Val<>""),
      lF, AND(f>=1, l2Val, REGEXMATCH(a, "360|4way|1way|싱글 덕트|싱글 실링|25년형|무풍갤러리")),
      nF, AND(f>=1,
               OR(
                 REGEXMATCH(a, "360|4way"),
                 AND(REGEXMATCH(a, "1way"), OR(n2Val="판넬제외", n2Val="공청판넬"))
               )
      ),
      oF, AND(f>=1, REGEXMATCH(a, "360"), o2Val<>""),
      jF, AND(f>=1, REGEXMATCH(a, "스탠드|벽걸이|가정용 에어컨"),
              OR(r2Val="포함", r2Val="별도")),
      joined, TEXTJOIN("/", TRUE,
        IF(kF, k2Val, ""),
        IF(lF, "리모컨 제외", ""),
        IF(nF, n2Val, ""),
        IF(oF, o2Val & "판넬", ""),
        IF(jF, IF(r2Val="포함", "자재포함", IF(r2Val="별도", "자재별도", "")), "")
      ),
      suf, IF(joined<>"", "(" & joined & ")", ""),
      IF(name<>"", name & suf, "")
    )
  )),
  singleArr, HSTACK(
    singleName,'싱글 세트'!C4:C,'싱글 세트'!D4:D,'싱글 세트'!F4:F,'싱글 세트'!E4:E,
    MAP('싱글 세트'!H4:H,LAMBDA(x,IF(x="","",x))),
    MAP('싱글 세트'!I4:I,LAMBDA(x,IF(x="","",x)))
  ),


  oldArr, HSTACK(
    '구형'!A4:A,'구형'!B4:B,'구형'!C4:C,'구형'!E4:E,'구형'!D4:D,
    MAP('구형'!F4:F,LAMBDA(x,IF(x="","",x))),
    MAP('구형'!G4:G,LAMBDA(x,IF(x="","",x)))
  ),

  emptyHome,   ARRAY_CONSTRAIN(homeArr,   0, COLUMNS(homeArr)),
  emptyComm,   ARRAY_CONSTRAIN(commArr,   0, COLUMNS(commArr)),
  emptySingle, ARRAY_CONSTRAIN(singleArr, 0, COLUMNS(singleArr)),
  emptyOld,    ARRAY_CONSTRAIN(oldArr,    0, COLUMNS(oldArr)),

  homeFilt,   IFNA(FILTER(homeArr,   INDEX(homeArr,,4)<>0),   emptyHome),
  commFilt,   IFNA(FILTER(commArr,   INDEX(commArr,,4)<>0),   emptyComm),
  singleFilt, IFNA(FILTER(singleArr, INDEX(singleArr,,4)<>0), emptySingle),
  oldFilt,    IFNA(FILTER(oldArr,    INDEX(oldArr,,4)<>0),    emptyOld),

  commA, IF(ROWS(commFilt), INDEX(commFilt,,1), ""),
  commF, IF(ROWS(commFilt), INDEX(commFilt,,4), ""),
  dvmmask, IF(ROWS(commFilt),
             MAP(commA, commF, LAMBDA(a,f,
               AND(N(f)<>0, IFERROR(REGEXMATCH(a, "DVM S2|가스히트펌프"), FALSE))
             )),
             SEQUENCE(0)
  ),
  commTop,  IFNA(FILTER(commFilt, dvmmask),       emptyComm),
  commRest, IFNA(FILTER(commFilt, NOT(dvmmask)),  emptyComm),
  commSorted, IF(ROWS(commTop)+ROWS(commRest),
                VSTACK( IF(ROWS(commTop),  commTop,  emptyComm),
                        IF(ROWS(commRest), commRest, emptyComm) ),
                emptyComm
  ),

  onlyItemsTemp, VSTACK(homeFilt, commSorted, singleFilt, oldFilt),
  onlyItems, IFNA(
    FILTER(
      onlyItemsTemp,
      (INDEX(onlyItemsTemp,,1)<>"") * ISERROR(SEARCH("합계", INDEX(onlyItemsTemp,,1)))
    ),
    ARRAY_CONSTRAIN(onlyItemsTemp,0,COLUMNS(onlyItemsTemp))
  ),
  totalSum, IF(ROWS(onlyItems),
               SUM(MAP(INDEX(onlyItems,,7), LAMBDA(x, VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(x, ",",""))))),
               0
  ),
  cutUnit, SWITCH(
    TRIM('전표생성폼'!B14),
    "10원",    10,
    "100원",   100,
    "1000원",  1000,
    "10000원", 10000,
    0
  ),
  cutAmt, IF(cutUnit>0, MOD(totalSum, cutUnit), 0),
  delta3, IF('전표생성폼'!A14, INT(totalSum*1.03) - totalSum, 0),

  sumRow, LAMBDA(arr,lbl,ttl,applyCut,deltaAmt,
    IF(ROWS(arr),
      LET(
        totalQty, SUM(INDEX(arr,,4)),
        amt, SUM(INDEX(arr,,7)),
        totalAmt, VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(amt, ",","")),
        cut, IF(applyCut, cutAmt, 0),
        totalResult, INT(totalAmt - cut + IF(applyCut, deltaAmt, 0)),
        VSTACK({lbl,"","","","","",""}, arr, {ttl,"","", totalQty,"","", totalResult})
      ),
      ARRAY_CONSTRAIN(arr,0,COLUMNS(arr))
    )
  ),

  homeHas,   ROWS(homeFilt)>0,
  commHas,   ROWS(commFilt)>0,
  singleHas, ROWS(singleFilt)>0,
  oldHas,    ROWS(oldFilt)>0,

  homeApplyCut,   AND(homeHas,   ROWS(onlyItems), INDEX(homeFilt,   1,1)=INDEX(onlyItems,1,1)),
  commApplyCut,   AND(commHas,   ROWS(onlyItems), INDEX(IF(ROWS(commSorted),commSorted,commFilt),1,1)=INDEX(onlyItems,1,1)),
  singleApplyCut, AND(singleHas, ROWS(onlyItems), INDEX(singleFilt,  1,1)=INDEX(onlyItems,1,1)),
  oldApplyCut,    AND(oldHas,    ROWS(onlyItems), INDEX(oldFilt,     1,1)=INDEX(onlyItems,1,1)),

  homeBlock,   IF(homeHas,   sumRow(homeFilt,   "<홈멀티>",    "홈멀티 합계",   homeApplyCut,   delta3),   emptyHome),
  commBlock,   IF(commHas,   sumRow(commSorted, "<상업멀티>",  "상업멀티 합계", commApplyCut,   delta3),   emptyComm),
  singleBlock, IF(singleHas, sumRow(singleFilt, "<싱글 세트>", "싱글세트 합계", singleApplyCut, delta3),   emptySingle),
  oldBlock,    IF(oldHas,    sumRow(oldFilt,    "<구형>",      "구형 합계",     oldApplyCut,    delta3),   emptyOld),

  blank, {"","","","","","",""},
  blocks, VSTACK(
    IF(commHas,   VSTACK(blank, commBlock),   emptyComm),
    IF(homeHas,   VSTACK(blank, homeBlock),   emptyHome),
    IF(singleHas, VSTACK(blank, singleBlock), emptySingle),
    IF(oldHas,    VSTACK(blank, oldBlock),    emptyOld)
  ),

  withQty,  IF(ROWS(blocks), HSTACK(blocks, INDEX(blocks,,4)), ARRAY_CONSTRAIN(blocks,0,COLUMNS(blocks))),
  finalArr, IF(ROWS(withQty), IFNA(FILTER(withQty, (INDEX(withQty,,8)<>0) + (INDEX(withQty,,1)="")), withQty), withQty),

  adjusted, MAP(SEQUENCE(ROWS(finalArr)), LAMBDA(r,
    LET(
      row, INDEX(finalArr, r, ),
      nval, INDEX(row, 4),
      uval, INDEX(row, 6),
      gval, INDEX(row, 7),
      uvalNum, IF(uval="", "", VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(uval, ",",""))),
      gvalNum, IF(gval="", "", VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(gval, ",",""))),
      calcPrice, IF(uval="", "", SIGN(nval)*IF(r=3, INT(uvalNum + ((-cutAmt + delta3)/nval)), uvalNum)),
      unitPrice, IF(calcPrice=0, "서비스 품목", calcPrice),
      newGval,   IF(gval="", "", IF(r=3, INT(gvalNum - cutAmt + delta3), gval)),
      HSTACK(INDEX(row,,1), INDEX(row,,2), INDEX(row,,3), INDEX(row,,4), INDEX(row,,5), unitPrice, newGval)
    )
  )),

  footerMsg, {
    "※ 분기관은 <임의 산정>입니다.";
    "※ 견적 내용 확정 시 재고확인 요청 부탁드립니다.";
    "※ 본 견적은 견적일로부터 <30일 이내>에만 유효합니다.";
    "※ 공공기관 발주 현장의 경우 본 견적은 무효이며, 별도의 검토가 필요합니다."
  },
  footerBlock, HSTACK(footerMsg, MAKEARRAY(ROWS(footerMsg), 6, LAMBDA(r,c, ""))),
  
  isVatSep, '전표생성폼'!D19,
  grandTotalLabel, IF(isVatSep, "전체합계 (VAT별도)", "전체합계 (VAT포함)"),
  grandTotalVal, INT(totalSum - cutAmt + delta3),
  grandTotalRow, HSTACK(grandTotalLabel, "", "", "", "", "", grandTotalVal),

  finalWithFooter, IF(ROWS(onlyItems), 
    VSTACK(adjusted, footerBlock), 
    adjusted
  ),

  finalWithFooter
), "")

=IFERROR(
  LET(
    commRawBase, HSTACK(
      '상업멀티 구성'!A2:A,
      '상업멀티 구성'!B2:B,
      '상업멀티 구성'!C2:C,
      '상업멀티 구성'!E2:E,
      '상업멀티 구성'!D2:D,
      MAP('상업멀티 구성'!F2:F, LAMBDA(x, IF(x="","", x))),
      MAP('상업멀티 구성'!G2:G, LAMBDA(x, IF(x="","", x))),
      '상업멀티 구성'!H2:H,
      MAP('상업멀티 구성'!A2:A, LAMBDA(_,"상업멀티"))
    ),
    commLcol, MAP(
      INDEX(commRawBase,,1),
      LAMBDA(code,
        LET(val, IFERROR(INDEX('상업멀티 구성'!J4:J, MATCH(code, '상업멀티 구성'!A4:A, 0)),""),
            IF(val="-","",val))
      )
    ),
    commRaw, HSTACK(commRawBase, commLcol),
    commTop,  IFERROR(FILTER(commRaw,  REGEXMATCH(INDEX(commRaw,,1), "DVM\s*S2|가스히트펌프")), {}),
    commRest, IFERROR(FILTER(commRaw, NOT(REGEXMATCH(INDEX(commRaw,,1), "DVM\s*S2|가스히트펌프"))), {}),
    commDvmFirst, VSTACK(commTop, commRest),
    homeArr, HSTACK(
      '홈멀티'!A4:A,
      '홈멀티'!B4:B,
      '홈멀티'!C4:C,
      '홈멀티'!E4:E,
      '홈멀티'!D4:D,
      MAP('홈멀티'!F4:F, LAMBDA(x, IF(x="","", x))),
      MAP('홈멀티'!G4:G, LAMBDA(x, IF(x="","", x))),
      '홈멀티'!I4:I,
      MAP('홈멀티'!A4:A, LAMBDA(_,"홈멀티")),
      MAP('홈멀티'!L4:L, LAMBDA(x, IF(x="-","",x)))
    ),
    singleNames, BYROW(
      SEQUENCE(ROWS('싱글 구성품'!A4:A)),
      LAMBDA(r,
        LET(
          code,INDEX('싱글 구성품'!A4:A,r),
          py,INDEX('싱글 구성품'!B4:B,r),
          name,INDEX('싱글 구성품'!D4:D,r),
          TRIM(code)&IF(py="",""," "&TRIM(py)&"평")&IF(name="",""," "&TRIM(name))
        )
      )
    ),
    singleArr, HSTACK(
      singleNames,
      '싱글 구성품'!C4:C,
      '싱글 구성품'!E4:E,
      '싱글 구성품'!G4:G,
      '싱글 구성품'!F4:F,
      MAP('싱글 구성품'!I4:I, LAMBDA(x, IF(x="","", x))),
      MAP('싱글 구성품'!J4:J, LAMBDA(x, IF(x="","", x))),
      '싱글 구성품'!L4:L,
      MAP('싱글 구성품'!A4:A, LAMBDA(_,"싱글 세트")),
      MAP('싱글 구성품'!A4:A, LAMBDA(_,""))
    ),
    oldArr, HSTACK(
      '구형'!A4:A,
      '구형'!B4:B,
      '구형'!C4:C,
      '구형'!E4:E,
      '구형'!D4:D,
      MAP('구형'!F4:F, LAMBDA(x, IF(x="","", x))),
      MAP('구형'!G4:G, LAMBDA(x, IF(x="","", x))),
      '구형'!I4:I,
      MAP('구형'!A4:A, LAMBDA(_,"구형")),
      MAP('구형'!L4:L, LAMBDA(x, IF(x="-","",x)))
    ),
    allArr, VSTACK(commDvmFirst, homeArr, singleArr, oldArr),
    onlyFilled, FILTER(allArr, INDEX(allArr,,4)<>0),
    n, ROWS(onlyFilled),
    model, INDEX(onlyFilled,,2),
    unit, INDEX(onlyFilled,,6),
    spec, INDEX(onlyFilled,,8),
    rownums, SEQUENCE(n),
    totalSum, SUM(MAP(INDEX(onlyFilled,,7), LAMBDA(x, VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(x, ",",""))))),

    cutUnit, SWITCH(
      TRIM('전표생성폼'!B14),
      "10원",    10,
      "100원",   100,
      "1000원",  1000,
      "10000원", 10000,
      0
    ),
    cutAmt, IF(cutUnit>0, MOD(totalSum, cutUnit), 0),

    delta3, IF('전표생성폼'!A14, INT(totalSum*1.03) - totalSum, 0),
    lastIdx, MAP(rownums, LAMBDA(r, MAX(FILTER(rownums, (model=INDEX(model,r))*(unit=INDEX(unit,r)))))),
    isLast, MAP(rownums, LAMBDA(r, INDEX(lastIdx, r)=r)),
    sumQtys, MAP(rownums, LAMBDA(r, IF(INDEX(isLast, r), SUM(FILTER(INDEX(onlyFilled,,4), (model=INDEX(model,r))*(unit=INDEX(unit,r)))), ""))),
    sumAmts, MAP(rownums, LAMBDA(r, IF(INDEX(isLast, r), SUM(FILTER(VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(INDEX(onlyFilled,,7),",","")), (model=INDEX(model,r))*(unit=INDEX(unit,r)))), ""))),
    specOut, MAP(rownums, LAMBDA(r, IF(OR(r=1, INDEX(spec,r)<>INDEX(spec,r-1)), INDEX(spec,r), ""))),
    resultArr, MAP(
      rownums,
      LAMBDA(r,
        IF(INDEX(isLast, r),
          HSTACK(
            IF(INDEX(onlyFilled,r,1)="-","",INDEX(onlyFilled,r,1)),
            IF(INDEX(onlyFilled,r,2)="-","",INDEX(onlyFilled,r,2)),
            IF(INDEX(onlyFilled,r,3)="-","",INDEX(onlyFilled,r,3)),
            INDEX(sumQtys, r),
            IF(INDEX(onlyFilled,r,5)="-","",INDEX(onlyFilled,r,5)),
            INDEX(onlyFilled,r,6),
            INDEX(sumAmts, r),
            INDEX(specOut, r),
            IF(INDEX(onlyFilled,r,9)="-","",INDEX(onlyFilled,r,9)),
            IF(INDEX(onlyFilled,r,10)="-","",INDEX(onlyFilled,r,10))
          ),
          HSTACK("","","","","","","","","","")
        )
      )
    ),
    rowsFiltered, ROWS(resultArr),
    filtered, FILTER(resultArr, INDEX(resultArr,,1)<>""),
    adjusted, MAP(
      SEQUENCE(rowsFiltered),
      LAMBDA(r,
        LET(
          row, INDEX(filtered, r, ),
          qty, INDEX(row, 4),
          unitV, INDEX(row, 6),
          amt, INDEX(row, 7),
          unitNum, IF(unitV="", "", VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(unitV, ",",""))),
          amtNum, IF(amt="", "", VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(amt, ",",""))),
          newUnit, IF(r=1, INT(unitNum + ((-cutAmt + delta3)/qty)), unitNum),
          newAmt,  IF(r=1, INT(amtNum  - cutAmt + delta3),          amtNum),
          HSTACK(
            IF(INDEX(row,,1)="-","",INDEX(row,,1)),
            IF(INDEX(row,,2)="-","",INDEX(row,,2)),
            IF(INDEX(row,,3)="-","",INDEX(row,,3)),
            qty,
            IF(INDEX(row,,5)="-","",INDEX(row,,5)),
            newUnit,
            newAmt,
            IF(INDEX(row,,8)="-","",INDEX(row,,8)),
            IF(INDEX(row,,9)="-","",INDEX(row,,9)),
            IF(INDEX(row,,10)="-","",INDEX(row,,10))
          )
        )
      )
    ),
    VSTACK(HSTACK("","","","","","","","","",""), FILTER(adjusted, INDEX(adjusted,,1)<>""))
  ),
"")

=LET(
  factor, E4:E12,
  countRaw, X4:X12,
  limitRange, E13:E70,
  
  hasData, COUNTIF(factor, ">=1"),

  IF(hasData = 0, "-",
    LET(
      cleanCount, ARRAYFORMULA(IFERROR(VALUE(REGEXREPLACE(TO_TEXT(countRaw), "[^0-9]", "")), 0)),
      totalVal, SUMPRODUCT(N(factor), cleanCount),
      limitVal, SUM(limitRange),

      IF(totalVal < limitVal, "⚠️ 실내기 최대 허용대수 의심", "✅ 실내기 최대 허용대수 양호")
    )
  )

     base,
     IF(meth="올림", CEILING(base, sig),
       IF(meth="내림", FLOOR(base, sig),
         MROUND(base, sig)
       )
     )
  )
)

=LET(
  factor, E4:E12,
  countRaw, X4:X12,
  limitRange, E13:E70,
  
  hasData, COUNTIF(factor, ">=1"),

  IF(hasData = 0, "-",
    LET(
      cleanCount, ARRAYFORMULA(IFERROR(VALUE(REGEXREPLACE(TO_TEXT(countRaw), "[^0-9]", "")), 0)),

    )
  )
)

=LET(
  pattern, "가스히트펌프|프레스티지|동시냉난방|공장전원",
  
  keys, LET(
    hmRange, '홈멀티'!B4:B410, cmRange, '상업멀티'!B4:B415, ssRange, '싱글 세트'!C4:C289,
    h, IFERROR(FILTER(hmRange, (N(OFFSET(hmRange,0,3))<>0)*REGEXMATCH(TO_TEXT(hmRange),"^(AJ|AM|AY)")), SEQUENCE(0,1)),
    cH, IFERROR(FILTER(cmRange, (N(OFFSET(cmRange,0,4))<>0)*REGEXMATCH(TO_TEXT(OFFSET(cmRange,0,-1)),pattern)*REGEXMATCH(TO_TEXT(cmRange),"^(AM|AN)")), SEQUENCE(0,1)),
    cC, IFERROR(FILTER(cmRange, (N(OFFSET(cmRange,0,4))<>0)*NOT(REGEXMATCH(TO_TEXT(OFFSET(cmRange,0,-1)),pattern))*REGEXMATCH(TO_TEXT(cmRange),"^(AM|AN)")), SEQUENCE(0,1)),
    s, IFERROR(FILTER(ssRange, (N(OFFSET(ssRange,0,3))<>0)*REGEXMATCH(TO_TEXT(ssRange),"^(AC|AP|AR|AF)")), SEQUENCE(0,1)),
    out, TRANSPOSE(TOCOL(VSTACK(h,cH,cC,s),3)),
    IF(COUNTA(out)=0, "", HSTACK("", out))
  ),

  BYCOL(keys, LAMBDA(k,
    LET(
      key, TO_TEXT(k),
      IF(key="", VSTACK(key, IF(SEQUENCE(27), "")),
        LET(
          hmR, '홈멀티'!B4:B410, cmR, '상업멀티'!B4:B415, ssR, '싱글 세트'!C4:C289,
